description: Rename batches of generic screenshots into descriptive names, and optionally turn a bug-report or feedback prompt into a polished HTML report that embeds the real screenshots beside each issue. Use when the user wants to: rename screenshots with generic names (e.g. "Screenshot 2026-04-08...", "SCR-...png"), improve a voice-dictated or AI-rewritten prompt that references images, build a readable bug/feedback report from screenshots, attach exact image references to a prompt, or do any combination of these. Triggers on: "rename my screenshots", "rename these images", "my prompt references screenshots", "I dictated this prompt", "turn these screenshots into a report", "prepare screenshots for Codex", "improve my prompt with the images".
